parsed.name: retail_attention_contrarian
parsed.strategy: I fade the retail-attention crowd: names whose only evidence is a headline spike (ALB, INTC, ORCL, MU, GEV, VRT, RGTI, QUBT, BYND, DNUT, GTLB, ABNB, AFRM, TGT, PLTR, AMD, RKLB, NBIS, BB, SNDK) get zero weight even where news counts are huge. I buy where revision_flow_90d shows broad net raises from many distinct firms and a dated catalyst sits inside Oct 12-Nov 13: pharma PDUFAs, semicap earnings, and enterprise software. I am wrong if the attention names keep running on flow alone, or if a PDUFA CRL or a capex-digestion headline hits several holdings at once.
parsed.objective: Beat the Bloomberg WLS index on relative P&L from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 by owning analyst-flow-confirmed catalyst names and refusing attention-only spikes.
